name: lecture-notes
description: Create and continuously refine one annotatable Notion Master Note per lecture from slides, transcripts, and inline study comments.

interface.shortDescription: Living, annotatable lecture notes in Notion
interface.longDescription: Use ChatGPT's built-in Notion app as the only persistent note surface. Create or locate one Notion Master Note per lecture, compare it against the current slides and transcript, update the same page, return its link, and process inline Notion comments by answering the discussion and integrating durable explanations into the relevant body section.
capabilities: Create one editable Notion Master Note per lecture
Locate and reuse the existing Notion Master Note instead of creating duplicates
Create notes from lecture slides and transcripts
Preserve formulas, proofs, examples, diagrams, and instructor additions actually taught
Respect the transcript-defined lecture coverage boundary
Check a current Master Note against source materials and repair omissions
Read inline Notion comments attached to selected text
Integrate durable answers into the relevant note section and reply in the original comment thread
Return the canonical Notion page link after creation or updates
defaultPrompt: Create or update my Notion Master Note from the uploaded slides and transcript. Use the built-in Notion app only, reuse the existing page for this lecture when one exists, and return the Notion link.

Process the comments on my current Notion Master Note: answer each unresolved study question, integrate durable explanations into the relevant body section, reply in the original comment thread, and keep using the same page.
Check my current Notion Master Note against the slides and transcript for missing or over-included knowledge, repair it in place, and return the page link.
